title.sr: Kralj Milan se vraća u Srbiju kao vrhovni komandant vojske
title.en: King Milan returns to Serbia as army commander-in-chief

description.sr: Kralj Milan se, na poziv sina kralja Aleksandra, vraća u Srbiju i postaje vrhovni komandant vojske, period poleta srpske vojske koji dovodi do nabavke Mauzerovih pušaka. Transkript navodi godinu kao '1827', što je Whisperova greška — Milan Obrenović je rođen 1854. godine, pa ta godina istorijski nije moguća; kontekst (period vladavine sina Aleksandra, kupovina Mauzerovih pušaka) upućuje na 1897/1898. godinu.
description.en: King Milan, at the invitation of his son King Alexander, returned to Serbia and became commander-in-chief of the army, a period of the Serbian army's rise that led to the purchase of Mauser rifles. The transcript states the year as '1827', a Whisper transcription error — Milan Obrenović was born in 1854, making that year historically impossible; the context (during his son Alexander's reign, purchase of Mauser rifles) points to 1897/1898.

events.quote: ali 1827. godine kralj Milan se vraća u Srbiju na poziv sina, nakon što su rešili svoje ... nesuglasice, gde on postaje zapravo general

title.sr: Prepravka jednometne puške u brzometnu (Milovanovićeva puška)
title.en: Conversion of a single-shot rifle into a repeating rifle (Milovanović rifle)

description.sr: 1906-1907. godine, nekoliko godina nakon smrti Koke Milovanovića (1905), sprovodi se prepravka jednometne puške u brzometnu i objavljuju konkursi inostranim fabrikama, ali se na kraju bira domaća konstrukcija, verovatno zbog cene.
description.en: In 1906-1907, a few years after Koka Milovanović's death (1905), a single-shot rifle was converted into a repeating one, and tenders were issued to foreign factories, but a domestic design was ultimately chosen, likely due to cost.

events.quote: Koka Milovanović je već umro, kao što smo rekli, 1905. Ovo se dešava tu nekdoko 1906. – 1907. godine.

title.sr: Nabavka ruskih pušaka pred Cersku bitku
title.en: Procurement of Russian rifles before the Battle of Cer

description.sr: 1914. godine, pred Cersku bitku, srpska vojska nabavlja rusko oružje da bi popunila nedostatak pušaka.
description.en: In 1914, ahead of the Battle of Cer, the Serbian army procured Russian weapons to make up for a shortage of rifles.

events.quote: sa koliko, možemo reći, 1914. godine i nabavkom ruskih pušaka pred samu Crsku bitku
